blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — While preparing for any eventuality is good, prosecution spokesperson Robert Ace Barbers believes that any verdict on Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial would not cause chaos or any disruption. In a press briefing on Monday, Barbers said that while the government cannot discount the fact that many would be displeased in case Duterte is convicted by the Senate Impeachment Court, he does not think that such protests would disrupt the peace and order situation in the country. Barbers said this after Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) Secretary Jonvic Remulla revealed in an ambush interview earlier […]...
